name: Aabid Hussain Shaikh
title: Full Stack & Mobile Developer
bio: Aabid Hussain Shaikh is a Navi Mumbai-based full-stack and mobile developer with 7+ years of experience building web applications, mobile apps, APIs, and scalable software systems.
aboutText: I started as a PHP developer, fell in love with Laravel's elegance, then expanded into Vue.js for reactive frontends. The mobile world called, and Flutter became my tool of choice for cross-platform apps. Today, I architect full-stack solutions that scale — from database design to deployment pipelines.
